problem:

$$
v=⟨\operatorname{ln}⁡(3t+1),1-{t}^{2}⟩,\,t>0.
$$

a(2)=⟨35,−7⟩
b
a(2)=⟨ln⁡3,−7⟩
c
a(2)=⟨ln⁡7,−4⟩
d
a(2)=⟨37,−2⟩

a(2)=⟨37,−4⟩
